aggregation_semantics: one row per participant account; count rows to count users
validation: users.Id is the primary key and is referenced by posts.OwnerUserId, posts.LastEditorUserId, comments.UserId, postHistory.UserId, badges.UserId and votes.UserId

aggregation_semantics: one row per post; count rows to count posts, optionally restricted by PostTypeId
validation: posts.Id is unique and is referenced by comments.PostId, votes.PostId, postHistory.PostId, postLinks.PostId and posts.ParentId

aggregation_semantics: one row per comment; count rows for comment volume
validation: comments.Id is the primary key; 174285 rows observed

aggregation_semantics: one row per badge award event; count rows per user to obtain that user's badge count
validation: badges.Id is the primary key; 79851 rows observed across 25078 distinct users

aggregation_semantics: one row per vote event; filter by VoteTypeId to isolate ordinary votes or bounty records
validation: votes.Id is the primary key; 38930 rows observed

aggregation_semantics: one row per catalogue tag entry
validation: tags.Id is the primary key; 1032 rows observed

aggregation_semantics: distinct label text of a catalogue tag
validation: TagName matches the labels embedded in question tag lists for the same tag

aggregation_semantics: maintained catalogue-wide usage count for the tag, not a per-question count
validation: Compared against the number of posts whose tag list contains the label: r 7244 versus 7240, variance 766 versus 766, ggplot2 78 versus 78

aggregation_semantics: one row per change event on a post
validation: postHistory.Id is the primary key; 303155 rows observed

semantic_filter: restricted to the content-change history types (title, body and tag edits) rather than the initial creation records
aggregation_semantics: count of edit events per post or per acting user
validation: Content-change types carry edit payloads such as a replacement title or a replacement tag list, while creation types carry the original content

aggregation_semantics: grouping dimension over posts
validation: Observed distribution: questions 42912, answers 47755, and small volumes of tag-excerpt, tag-wiki, moderation and placeholder records

semantic_filter: only records whose post type denotes a question
aggregation_semantics: count of question posts; the population for title, tag and view analysis
validation: 42912 question posts; every post carrying a tag list or a view count belongs to this type

semantic_filter: only records whose post type denotes an answer
aggregation_semantics: count of answer posts
validation: 47755 answer posts; none carry a title, tag list or view count

aggregation_semantics: grouping dimension over vote records
validation: Observed types: ordinary up and down votes dominate (33323 and 1451), bounty-open type 60 rows, bounty-close type 59 rows, plus small governance volumes

aggregation_semantics: grouping dimension over revision records
validation: Observed initial-record types carry the original title, body or tag list; the title-edit, body-edit and tag-edit types carry 16008, 69413 and 12731 rows respectively

aggregation_semantics: one name per user account; a name may map to several accounts
validation: 40325 accounts versus 35644 distinct names; the most repeated name occurs 80 times

aggregation_semantics: name of the user who performed the revision
validation: Populated for all 303155 revision records

aggregation_semantics: name of the comment author
validation: Populated for only 2831 of 174285 comments, so it is unreliable as a general commenter name source

aggregation_semantics: name of the post creator when the account is not recorded
validation: Populated for only 2509 of 91966 posts, and 1388 of those rows carry no owner identifier

aggregation_semantics: name of the most recent editor of the post
validation: Populated for only 465 of 91966 posts

aggregation_semantics: one headline per question post
validation: Title is populated only for question posts; case-insensitive matching is required to locate a title quoted in a question

aggregation_semantics: membership of a label in the post's tag list, tested by exact label match within the delimited string
grain: one delimited label string per question post
validation: Labels are wrapped in angle brackets, as in the observed value for a tag question; substring tests that ignore the delimiters can match unintended labels

aggregation_semantics: age in completed years at record time; recorded agerange observed 13 to 94
validation: Present for 8318 of 40325 accounts; 32007 accounts have no recorded age

aggregation_semantics: accumulated per-account total; never null; observed range 1 to 87393
validation: Populated for all 40325 accounts

semantic_filter: the single account holding the highest reputation value defines the most influential user
aggregation_semantics: maximum reputation over accounts, used as a ranking reduction
grain: one value per user account, reduced to one account
validation: Reputation maximum observed at 87393

aggregation_semantics: count of award rows grouped by the user the award belongs to
validation: 2875 users hold more than five award rows; the busiest account holds 456

aggregation_semantics: integer net standing per post; may be negative; average over a set of posts gives the mean post score
validation: Observed range -19 to 192, with 1020 posts below zero

aggregation_semantics: cumulative view total per question post; sum or maximum across posts to compare popularity
validation: All 42912 question posts carry a view count; all 47755 answer posts have none

aggregation_semantics: count of bookmarks on the post
validation: Absent for 78723 of 91966 posts, concentrated in non-question post types

semantic_filter: restricted to bounty-related vote types; null for every other vote record
aggregation_semantics: bounty size in reputation points carried by a single bounty vote record
grain: one value per bounty vote record
validation: Non-null only on vote type 8 (60 of 60 rows) and vote type 9 (41 of 59 rows); every other type carries null

aggregation_semantics: minimum vote date per casting user yields that user's first vote
validation: For the user named chl the earliest vote date resolves to 2010-08-13

aggregation_semantics: minimum award timestamp for a named badge yields the first holder or the first award moment
validation: The earliest Autobiographer award timestamp is 2010-07-19 19:39:09.0 and is shared by many accounts

semantic_filter: the numerator and denominator are both counts of post records, the denominator being the reference population named in the question
aggregation_semantics: conditioned count of posts divided by the count of the stated reference population, expressed as a percentage
validation: Workload ratios differ only by their denominator, which is either all posts, posts in a year, or posts of one author

aggregation_semantics: groups posts by their creating account
validation: Every non-null owner identifier resolves to an existing account; 211 posts are owned by the synthetic Community account

aggregation_semantics: identifies only the most recent editor of a post
validation: Null for 47361 of 91966 posts; where present it equals the owner in 23429 of 44605 cases, so it cannot distinguish creators from later editors

aggregation_semantics: enumerates every user who changed the post, not only the latest one
validation: The acting user is recorded for 281829 of 303155 revision records

semantic_filter: absence of a value means the post has never been closed
aggregation_semantics: presence or absence of the closure timestamp classifies the post as closed or open
validation: 1610 of 91966 posts carry a closure timestamp; the remaining 90356 have none
